records.question: Marnie makes bead bracelets. She bought 5 bags of 50 beads and 2 bags of 100 beads. If 50 beads are used to make one bracelet, how many bracelets will Marnie be able to make out of the beads she bought?
records.response:
Marnie bought 5 bags of 50 beads, so she has 5*50 = 250 beads from the 50 bead bags.
Marnie also bought 2 bags of 100 beads, so she has 2*100 = 200 beads from the 100 bead bags.
In total, Marnie has 250+200 = 450 beads.
If 50 beads are used to make one bracelet, then Marnie can make 450/50 = 9 bracelets.
#### 9
